authority.name: Ruff Lint
authority.notes: The repository-root pyproject.toml is authoritative for ruff. run_fast_checks.sh runs from backend/ but inherits root config.

authority.name: Black Format
authority.notes: Repository-root pyproject.toml is authoritative for black.

authority.name: Mypy Typecheck (two boundaries)
authority.canonical_command: python -m mypy .  # repo scope;  python -m mypy src/  # backend strict scope
authority.notes: Root mypy excludes backend/; backend has its own STRICT boundary. Do not conflate the two scopes.

authority.name: Pytest
authority.canonical_command: python -m pytest tests/unit/ -x -q  # backend;  python -m pytest runtime/tests/  # runtime
authority.notes: Backend and runtime have separate pytest rootdirs.

authority.name: Coverage (C47 canonical)
authority.notes: Canonical coverage path goes through verify.py; raw coverage run is non-canonical.

authority.name: Mutation Testing (C47)
authority.notes: Mutmut config is backend-scoped; full campaigns require human authorization.
